data.name: Dagger (Base)
data.description: This black +1 dagger has a serrated edge. It allows the wielder to use a poison effect (as the spell, save DC 14) upon a creature struck by the blade once per day. The wielder can decide to use the power after he has struck. Doing so is a free action, but the poison effect must be invoked in the same round that the dagger strikes.

source.original_ingest_defect: same-line 'DESC:.CLEAR' sentinel followed by a real DESC: token on the same corpus row; an earlier codegen pass captured only the .CLEAR sentinel (SD-25 criterion 7.N fix)
